_source: rm, cp, mv, touch, rmdir and mkdir run with sh -c in containers of these images (docker run -d, one docker exec per case), 2026-10-20. Every case starts in a fresh /tmp/w (folders d (with file d/f), e, t; files file, a, b; a root-owned folder /r mode 0755; cwd /tmp/w); uid 1000 cases are in the _user entries (for /r/x of 'rm -f /r/x' and /r/y of 'rm /r/y' a root-owned file was created first, 'rm /r/x' has none). Docker host is linux/arm64: every image ran as arm64, except debian:8 (linux/arm, 32 bit) and busybox 1.25 / 1.26 (linux/amd64 only, emulated); see the platform field. LC_ALL as in the locale field ('unset' for BusyBox). rockylinux:9 has no en_US.UTF-8 by default, so glibc-langpack-en was installed (dnf) in the running container before recording; debian_12_en is debian:12 with the locales package installed and en_GB.UTF-8 generated (apt-get install locales, locale-gen); the debian_12 entry is a clean container. The BusyBox ls has no -e from 1.27 on ('ls -le' is recorded anyway and shows the error there), so every BusyBox touch case with ls exists twice: 'ls -le' and 'ls -l --full-time'. Normalised: only the seconds of BusyBox 'touch -d '2024-01-02 15:30'' (BusyBox takes the seconds from the clock; 15:30:SS), found by running the case twice 1.2 s apart. No other time of day is volatile (all other times are set by touch or are those of image files, which are fixed per image). Volatile, kept as run: the stderr of BusyBox 'rm -rf /' as uid 1000 lists every file of the image it cannot remove (order and exact content differ between runs). The libc of a BusyBox image was read from the binary (static uclibc / musl by strerror table, glibc by ld-linux): busybox:1.25 to 1.33 are uclibc, 1.33.1-musl musl, 1.34 / 1.35 glibc. busybox:1.24 cannot be pulled (see report.md). The mkdir cases (mkdir -pv d1/d2, mkdir /tmp, mkdir --help) were run in every image, including debian:8 (coreutils 8.23) and debian:9 (8.26). The stderr of BusyBox 'rm -rf /' (uid 1000) is cut to its first 20 lines: the real output is 1.6 to 1.8 MB (about 20000 lines) because it walks /proc and /sys of the host kernel too and differs from run to run; exit status is real. Firmware entries (fw_*): the BusyBox of the firmware under qemu-user, each applet called as `busybox APPLET ...` (compound cases split into their calls); the loader's warning about the container's ld.so.cache is removed from stderr. Wave 1 (2026-10-21) added the firmware of the NAS326 (fw_zyxel_nas326_aazf18), the DIR-859 (fw_dlink_dir859_105b03) and QNAP's build of QTS 5.2.3 (src_qnap_1.24.1, natively on amd64); see the image notes. Wave 1 (2026-10-21) added the cases of rm -v / -I / -i with piped answers, cp and mv onto the same file, into themselves and -T, the full --version texts, mkdir without operands and with a bad mode, rmdir -v and the permission cases of touch, cp -r, mv and rm -r under /r (uid 1000); debian:12 and debian:13 were pulled under a newer digest (digest_w1), the same coreutils. The firmware entries got the wave 1 cases too (fw/help2 of the recording notes), except the uid 1000 cases that need a file made first (/r/w, /r/v, /r/y): their runner makes none.
